observations: Photo 0 is the only photo: a cream domestic sewing machine head on a tiled floor.
The front panel reads 'IDEAL TOPSTAR' and 'Super Automatic' in photo 0.
Stitch selector dials on the right side and an 'UNTEN / OBEN' control below them; a stitch pattern window across the top.
A black electric foot pedal and power cable are attached, so this is an electric machine, not a hand-crank or treadle one.
The machine is dusty and grimy, with a pink stain on the free arm bed.
No carry case, table, bobbin, accessories or power-on clip is shown, and the machine is not shown sewing.

risks.risk: Faulty or unsafe foot pedal or power cable
risks.proof: Clip of the motor speeding up and slowing down with the pedal
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new pedal and cable

risks.risk: Missing bobbin case, bobbin, presser feet or cover plates
risks.proof: Photo of the bobbin area opened and of all accessories included
risks.if_unproven: as missing bobbin case and accessories

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or broken stitch selector
risks.proof: Photos of the back and underside of the machine and a clip turning each dial

proof_requests: Clip of the machine plugged in and sewing a line of stitches on fabric, with a handwritten code in shot
Photo of the bobbin area opened, showing the bobbin case and hook
Photo of the back and underside of the machine
Photo of all accessories, bobbins and presser feet included
response.reason: The brand and model are read off the front panel in photo 0, so it can be priced as an Ideal Topstar electric domestic sewing machine at its worst case, as not working and without accessories, until a sewing clip is shown.
